#--------------------------------

actor Client
participant Server
participant Handler
participant Service
participant DataAccess
database db

entryspacing 0.9
group#43829c #lightblue Registration
Client -> Server: [POST] /user\n{"username":" ", "password":" ", "email":" "}
Server -> Handler: {"username":" ", "password":" ", "email":" "}
break Invalid request data (username, password, and/or email)
 Handler --> Server: IllegalArgumentException
  Server --> Client: 400\n{"message": "Error: bad request"}
end
Handler -> Service: register(RegisterRequest)
break Missing fields or password length too short
  Service -->Server: IllegalArgumentException
  Server --> Client: 400\n{"message": "Error: bad request"}
end
Service -> DataAccess: getUser(username)
DataAccess -> db:Find UserData by username
break User with username already exists
  DataAccess --> Service: UserData
  Service --> Server: AlreadyTakenException
  Server --> Client: 403\n{"message": "Error: already taken"}
end
DataAccess --> Service: null
Service -> DataAccess:createUser(userData)
DataAccess -> db:Add UserData
Service -> Service: generate authToken
Service -> DataAccess:createAuth(AuthData(userName, authToken))
DataAccess -> db:Add AuthData
Service --> Handler: AuthorizedUserResult
Handler --> Server: {"username" : " ", "authToken" : " "}
Server --> Client: 200\n{"username" : " ", "authToken" : " "}

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end

group#orange #FCEDCA Login
Client -> Server: [POST] /session\n{username, password}
Server -> Handler: {username, password}
break Invalid request data (username and/or password)
  Handler --> Server: IllegalArgumentException
  Server --> Client: 400\n{"message": "Error: bad request"}
end
Handler -> Service: login(LoginRequest)
Service -> DataAccess: getUser(userName)
DataAccess -> db:Find UserData by userName
break User does not exist
  DataAccess --> Service: null
  Service --> Server: UnauthorizedException
  Server --> Client: 401\n{ "message": "Error: unauthorized" }
end
DataAccess --> Service: UserData
Service -> Service: validate password
break password is incorrect
  Service --> Server: UnauthorizedException
  Server --> Client: 401\n{ "message": "Error: unauthorized" }
end
Service ->Service: Generate new authToken
Service -> DataAccess:createAuth(AuthData(userName, authToken))
DataAccess -> db:Add AuthData
DataAccess -->Service: AuthData
Service --> Handler: AuthorizedUserResult
Handler --> Server: {"username" : " ", "authToken" : " "}
Server --> Client: 200\n{"username": " ", "authToken": " "}

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end

group#green #lightgreen Logout
Client -> Server: [DELETE] /session\nauthorization: <authToken>
Server ->Handler: {"authToken"}
Handler ->Service: logout(AuthorizationRequest)
Service ->DataAccess: getAuthData(AuthorizationRequest.authToken)
DataAccess -> db: Find AuthData
break authToken doesn't exist
  DataAccess -->Service: null
  Service -->Server: UnauthorizedException("Invalid token")
  Server -->Client: 401\n{"message": "Error: unauthorized"}
end
DataAccess --> Service: AuthData
Service -> DataAccess: deleteAuthData(authToken)
DataAccess -> db: delete AuthData
DataAccess -->Service: void (absence of an exception)
Service --> Handler: void (absence of an  exception)
Handler --> Server: void (absence of an exception)
Server --> Client: 200 {}

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end

group#red #pink List Games
Client -> Server: [GET] /game\nAuthorization: <authToken>
Server -> Handler: {"authToken"}
Handler -> Service: listGames(AuthorizationRequest)
Service -> DataAccess: getAuthData(AuthorizationRequest.authToken)
DataAccess -> db: Find AuthData
break authToken does not exist
  DataAccess --> Service: null
  Service --> Server: UnauthorizedException("Invalid token")
  Server --> Client: 401\n{"message": "Error: unauthorized"}
end
DataAccess --> Service: AuthData
Service -> DataAccess: getAllGames()
DataAccess -> db: Get all games
DataAccess --> Service: List<GameData>
Service --> Handler: GameListResult
Handler --> Server: {"games": [{"gameID": #, "whiteUsername": " ", "blackUsername": " ", "gameName": " "}, ...]}
Server --> Client: 200\n{"games": [{"gameID": #, "whiteUsername": " ", "blackUsername": " ", "gameName": " "}, ...]}

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end

group#d790e0 #E3CCE6 Create Game
Client -> Server: [POST] /game\nauthorization: <authToken>\n{gameName}
Server -> Handler: {"authToken", "gameName"}
Handler -> Service: createGame(AuthorizationRequest, gameName)
Service -> Service: validate gameName
break Invalid game name
Service -->Server: IllegalArgumentException
Server -->Client: 400\n{"message": "Error: bad request"}
end
Service -> DataAccess: getAuthData(AuthorizationRequest.authToken)
DataAccess -> db: Find AuthData
break authToken does not exist
  DataAccess --> Service: null
  Service --> Server: UnauthorizedException("Invalid token")
  Server --> Client: 401\n{"message": "Error: unauthorized"}
end
DataAccess --> Service: AuthData
Service ->DataAccess: findGameByName(gameName)
DataAccess -> db: Find game by name
break game name conflict
DataAccess -->Service: GameData
Service -->Server: AlreadyTakenException
Server -->Client: 403\n{"message": "Error: already taken"}
end
DataAccess -->Service: null
Service -> DataAccess: createGame(gameName)
DataAccess -> db: Create game
DataAccess --> Service: GameData
Service --> Handler: gameID
Handler --> Server: {"gameID": gameID}
Server --> Client: 200\n{"gameID": gameID}

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end

group#yellow #lightyellow Join Game #black
Client -> Server: [PUT] /game\nauthorization: <authToken>\n{playerColor, gameID}
Server -> Handler: {"authToken", "playerColor", "gameID"}
Handler -> Service: joinGame(AuthorizationRequest, playerColor, gameID)
Service -> Service: validate playerColor & gameID
break Invalid color or invalid gameID
Service -->Server: IllegalArgumentException
Server -->Client: 400\n{"message": "Error: bad request"}
end
Service -> DataAccess: getAuthData(AuthorizationRequest.authToken)
DataAccess -> db: Find AuthData
break authToken does not exist
  DataAccess --> Service: null
  Service --> Server: UnauthorizedException("Invalid token")
  Server --> Client: 401\n{"message": "Error: unauthorized"}
end
DataAccess --> Service: AuthData
Service -> DataAccess: getGame(gameID)
DataAccess -> db: Find Game
break requested game doesn't exist
DataAccess -->Service: null
Service -->Server: GameNotFoundException
Server -->Client: 400\n{"message": "Error: bad request"}
end
DataAccess -->Service: GameData
Service -> Service: requested color available?
alt color not available
Service --> Server: AlreadyTakenException
Server --> Client: 403\n{"message": "Error: already taken"}
else color available
Service ->DataAccess: updateGame(GameData)
DataAccess -> db: Update GameData
Service -->Handler: void (absence of an exception)
Handler --> Server: void (absence of an exception)
Server --> Client: 200 {}
end

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end

group#gray #lightgray Clear application
Client -> Server: [DELETE] /db
Server -> Handler: dispatch DELETE db
Handler -> Service: deleteDatabase()
Service -> DataAccess: deleteDatabase()
DataAccess -> db: Delete all GameData
DataAccess -> db: Delete all AuthData
DataAccess -> db: Delete all UserData
Service -->Handler: void (absence of an exception)
Handler --> Server: void (absence of an exception)
Server --> Client: 200 {}

break Unexpected failure during any preceding operation
alt Database failure
  DataAccess --> Service: DataAccessException
  Service --> Server: DataAccessException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: database failure"}
else Unexpected programming/runtime failure
  Service --> Server: RuntimeException
  Server --> Client: 500\n{"message": "Error: <description>"}
end
end
end
